title: Applied AI Engineer
description: About the jobWe build production AI agent systems for enterprise clients across financial services, health, government and telco, where "it worked in the demo" isn't good enough. This isn't prompt engineering or wiring an LLM to a vector database. You'll be doing harness design, loop engineering, context engineering and spec-driven builds: the actual discipline behind agents that hold up in production, under audit, at a client that can't tolerate a shadow AI incident.This is also DX1's feeder role into our Forward-Deployed Engineer programme. Engineers who build well here, meet the FDE selection criteria and complete the certification pathway are on track for conditional promotion into FDE, where you embed directly with clients and own delivery end to end.Key ResponsibilitiesDesign and build production-grade AI systems: agentic architectures, multi-model orchestration, RAG pipelines, tool use and MCP integrations.Build and run evaluation frameworks so agent behaviour in production is measurable and defensible: eval suites, regression tests, OpenTelemetry-based tracing and monitoring.Design the harness an agent operates inside (tools, permissions, state, guardrails) and the loop it runs (plan, act, observe, correct), not just the prompt in front of it.Work from clear specs that hold up under review, taking systems from prototype through to deployment, CI/CD and operational runbooks.Apply AI-specific security controls: input validation, output controls, PII detection, audit trails, and protections against prompt injection and excessive agency.Contribute reusable assets (agent templates, integration patterns, compliance packs) to DX1's asset library so every engagement after yours starts further ahead.Required Qualifications and Experience2+ years in production software engineering, with systems you've actually shipped and operated.Production experience building on LLMs: RAG pipelines, agent development, prompt and context engineering, evaluation.Strong Python and/or TypeScript.Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and containerised deployment.Experience instrumenting production systems with OpenTelemetry for tracing and observability, ideally extended to agent or LLM workloads (tool calls, reasoning steps, latency and cost per step).Ability to work from a scoped spec and deliver without close supervision, and to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.Certification and Growth PathDX1 funds your certification path from day one: AWS Certified AI Practitioner and Anthropic's Claude Certified Architect (CCA) Foundations within your first six months. These double as the two pre-requisites for progression into the FDE programme. DX1 also holds AWS partner accreditation for generative AI.Bonus PointsExperience deploying agents on AWS Bedrock with Anthropic models (or a similar managed model platform), rather than just calling a raw API.Background in consulting or client-facing delivery.Knowledge of Australian data privacy regulations and AI governance frameworks. title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description: About UsInference Group is a fast-growing data and AI consultancy dedicated to helping organisations unlock their true potential through the transformative power of data, machine learning, and AI.We work with customers to turn cutting-edge ideas into scalable, operational solutions that enhance human decision-making and drive sustainable growth. Built by a team of curious, passionate technologists, Inference Group combines deep technical expertise with a practical, delivery-focused mindset. As we grow, we’re looking for like-minded people who are excited by lifelong learning, eager to challenge existing ways of working, and motivated to make a real impact in an AI-driven world.Role OverviewWe’re looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to join a major business transformation programme for one of our enterprise clients.The programme is rethinking how core business processes operate and exploring how AI agents, intelligent automation and AI-enabled workflows can fundamentally improve the way work gets done.You’ll work alongside business transformation specialists, consultants and engineers to understand existing processes, identify opportunities for AI and automation, and then design and build solutions that work in practice.This is not primarily a traditional machine learning or model-training role. We’re looking for someone who enjoys building with modern generative AI technologies — creating agents, orchestrating workflows, integrating AI with enterprise systems and rapidly turning business problems into working solutions.The client environment uses Google Cloud and Gemini, alongside Microsoft Copilot, although we’re open to candidates who have built agentic solutions using other platforms such as Claude, OpenAI or similar technologies.Location: London. Remote. Candidates should be comfortable working closely with client teams and attending client or London offices as required.Candidates must already have the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.Key Responsibilities will IncludeDesign, build and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows to solve real business problems.Translate redesigned business processes into practical AI and automation solutions.Build multi-step AI workflows that can reason, retrieve information, interact with systems and complete defined business tasks.Develop prototypes quickly and evolve successful concepts into robust, production-ready solutions.Work with Google Cloud, Gemini and associated AI technologies within the client environment.Integrate generative AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, data sources and existing workflows.Explore opportunities to use Microsoft Copilot and the wider Microsoft ecosystem alongside other AI platforms.Implement techniques such as prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling, retrieval-augmented generation and agent orchestration.Evaluate the effectiveness, reliability and quality of AI-generated outputs and agent behaviour.Build appropriate guardrails, monitoring and human-in-the-loop controls around AI solutions.Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand processes, pain points and opportunities for transformation.Work closely with consultants, product specialists, data engineers and other technical teams to take ideas from concept through to delivery.Experiment with emerging AI tools and frameworks and help determine where they can create genuine business value.Clearly explain technical approaches, limitations and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.What You BringWe’re on the lookout for someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with genuine hands-on experience building with modern generative AI technologies.You’ll ideally bring experience in some or all of the following:Hands-on experience building AI agents, agentic applications or AI-powered automated workflows.Strong programming skills, particularly Python.Experience working with large language models such as Gemini, Claude, OpenAI GPT models or equivalent.Experience using LLM APIs and building applications around them.Prompt engineering and designing reliable structured interactions with LLMs.Tool calling / function calling and enabling agents to interact with external systems.Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search.API development and integration with enterprise applications and data sources.Designing multi-step AI workflows and orchestrating interactions between models, tools and systems.Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, guardrails and responsible AI principles.Experience moving AI solutions beyond proof of concept into usable, production environments.Good software engineering practices, including version control, testing and deployment.Confidence working directly with business stakeholders and translating ambiguous business problems into technical solutions.An experimental mindset and genuine curiosity about the rapidly evolving generative AI landscape.Relevant Experience: Experience with any of the following would be highly valuable but you do not need to have worked specifically with Google Cloud or Gemini if you have strong hands-on experience building agentic AI solutions using another modern AI platform. We care most about your ability to understand how agents work, build them effectively and apply them to real business problems.Google Cloud PlatformGemini / Vertex AIGoogle Agent Development Kit or other agent frameworksMicrosoft Copilot / Copilot StudioClaude / AnthropicOpenAILangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI or similar orchestration frameworksVertex AI Agent BuilderGenerative AI application developmentWorkflow automationEnterprise API integrationProcess automation or business process transformationData engineering or cloud-native application developmentThe Kind of Person Who Will Thrive HereYou’ll probably enjoy this role if you:Like turning new AI capabilities into things people can actually use.Are constantly experimenting with new models, tools and frameworks.Enjoy solving loosely defined problems rather than waiting for detailed specifications.Can move comfortably between understanding a business process and writing the code that improves it.Know that an impressive AI demo is only the beginning — reliability, integration and adoption matter too.Can challenge an approach when there is a simpler or more effective solution.Enjoy working collaboratively with clients and multidisciplinary teams.Are excited by the opportunity to help shape how a large organisation adopts AI at scale.Working With Us:At Inference Group, we’re a young and fast-growing consultancy built by people who are naturally curious and passionate about lifelong learning. If you’re driven and want to help shape the early stages of a dynamic business, we’d love to have you on board. You’ll be part of a team exploring the limitless opportunities of data and AI, driving excellence, growing together, and we’ll be having plenty of fun along the way.We’re committed to hiring future leaders who will help shape our next chapter, and we’ll invest in your growth through access to the latest technology, hands-on experience, mentorship and ongoing training and certifications. As AI continues to evolve, we promise our clients a team of people who stay ahead of the curve, equipped with the most up-to-date knowledge and skills to deliver truly innovative solutions. Our Values are:> We Geek Out Loud: we excel in our data and AI domain, using our expertise to deliver solutions that realise value. We share our wisdom and experience proudly, no egos, just pure tech passion.> We Act Boldly, and Collaborate Openly: we explore uncharted territories, working on the new to deliver operational solutions at scale. We don’t tread over old ground. We collaborate openly with full transparency, learning from each other as a community.> We are the Connectors: we bridge the gaps between business value, data engineering, data science and deployment. Working seamlessly as one unified team internally and externally to deliver working solutions for our clients.> We Empower our Customers: we equip our clients with the skills and knowledge to fully leverage, scale and deploy data and AI solutions. We prioritise delivering operational success over prototypes and proof of concepts to provide long term value. We build trust.> We Love our Work: we are proud of the work we do and take ownership of it. We work on the things we love and care about, we work with passion with people we respect.> We are Data Jedis: we work on hard problems and aim to deliver working solutions at scale. We don’t have time for politics, backbiting, gossiping, game playing or selfish behaviour. We work as one team with a mission to deliver and we will only achieve that together. Show more Show less
